reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it presents a OneCoin company promotion that links joining with a minimum investment to claimed unlimited gains, future price growth, and token trading or mining opportunities. It also previews a compensation plan and invokes claimed legal certification to support participation, while the material does not establish actual returns or completed purchases.

citations.quote: here I am to do the first presentation from the onecoin company
all packs contain free tokens, tokens can be exchanged with other members of the internal exchange or used to buy more space to minerate the Don-Coin
The members can create their own currency, mine it and get their profits.
the profits of the first ones who are already joining the company will be with a minimum investment, because the price will increase over time.

opening.argument: The presentation uses prospective and conditional language rather than documenting a completed financial outcome. It says members “can” create currency, mine, and get profits, and describes future exchange activity and a later explanation of the compensation plan. Those are forward-looking claims for viewers to evaluate, not proof that any return is guaranteed or that participation has already produced one. The presentation also identifies an educational context and explains the proposed model rather than reporting a specific transaction or payout.

citations.quote: The members can create their own currency, mine it and get their profits.
You can also uses them to merge in mining pools and get reais or coins growing according to the coin.
In the next video we will explain to you the compensation plan, how it works and what you need to do to get the win for the company.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference argument treats promotional optimism as a guaranteed return, but “can” and “will” describe a proposed system and future plans, not a completed payout. Its cited minimum-investment statement is a prediction about price growth, while the record does not establish that the prediction was guaranteed or fulfilled. The preview of a compensation plan likewise shows that the details were not even presented here.

citations.quote: The members can create their own currency, mine it and get their profits.
In the next video we will explain to you the compensation plan, how it works and what you need to do to get the win for the company.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The conditional wording does not neutralize the solicitation. The presentation expressly connects membership with mining and profits, tells viewers that early participants can profit with minimum investment, and predicts price increases. Calling these statements forecasts does not make them neutral commentary when they are presented as reasons to join. The fact that a payout is not shown is evidence of an unverified promise, not evidence that the promotion is ordinary.

opening.argument: The video's stated central activity is education about cryptocurrency use. It describes OneAcademy as teaching exchanges through videos, presentations, and online questions, and says the packs provide skills for understanding cryptocurrency, trading, and price movements. The visual presentation likewise labels OneAcademy as the principal activity and describes five education levels. On that record, the material can be understood as an operational introduction to a proposed cryptocurrency platform and its learning products, rather than evidence of a completed scam transaction.

citations.quote: Now let's talk a little bit about one academy, the main activity of oneCoin. which will teach you how to make exchanges in a safe way with cryptocurrencies

which will teach you how to make exchanges in a safe way with cryptocurrencies and will help you acquire the necessary skills with interactive materials such as videos, presentations and online questions.
what a cryptocurrency is

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference side selects the mining and profit features but does not establish that they are the video's sole or primary purpose. The presentation explicitly calls OneAcademy the main activity and describes interactive educational materials and trading skills. Explaining how tokens might be used within the proposed platform is consistent with describing the platform's operation; it does not itself prove that viewers were charged or received returns.

citations.quote: the main activity of oneCoin
interactive materials such as videos, presentations and online questions

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The educational packaging is part of the inducement, not a defense to the financial mechanism. The same presentation says the educational packs contain tokens that can buy mining space, and says those tokens can be used to mine OneCoin. Teaching trading or explaining cryptocurrency does not change that the offered educational product is tied to mining capacity and claimed profits.

citations.quote: all packs contain free tokens, tokens can be exchanged with other members of the internal exchange or used to buy more space to minerate the Don-Coin
Designed to help you earn profits with the cryptocurrencies negotiation

opening.argument: The observable offer can be read as a product-and-platform promotion: educational packs, tokens, an internal exchange, and proposed mining pools. The description directs viewers to registration and detailed information, while the presentation explains possible token uses such as exchange, splitting, or joining a mining pool. However, the supplied material does not specify a cash price for a pack or mining space, show a payment request, identify a completed purchase, or document a realized return. It therefore does not establish the concrete deposit-and-payout mechanism required to characterize an ordinary transaction as a scam.

citations.quote: Register here:
all packs contain free tokens, tokens can be exchanged with other members of the internal exchange or used to buy more space to minerate the Don-Coin
The OneXchange is a robust exchange platform and the place where all negotiation occur.

rebuttal.rebuttal: A registration link and discussion of token uses do not show that a viewer paid money or that the promoter guaranteed a payout. The reference relies on the phrase “minimum investment,” but it does not supply a price, payment method, purchase record, or completed return. The existence of a proposed exchange and mining option is not by itself proof of a deceptive transaction.

citations.quote: Register here:
The OneXchange is a robust exchange platform and the place where all negotiation occur.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The missing completed purchase is not decisive because the relevant question is what the video promotes. It tells viewers that packs provide tokens, that tokens can purchase mining space, and that mining can produce coins and profits. The presentation also says early joiners can obtain profits with minimum investment. Those linked participation and return claims supply the mechanism even without a displayed price or completed transaction.
